game_title: Strip And Replace – Peak Beacon Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon, the beacon on the peak: the sherpa guide must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon: the beacon on the peak
core_gameplay_loop: In Peak Beacon, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the radio mast using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the radio mast is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Strip And Replace' (Week 8 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Peak Beacon'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Peak Beacon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 16.
